title: neottia bungeana
intro: Neottia bungeana, commonly known as the Chinese orchid, is a type of terrestrial orchid native to China. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Neottia bungeana include reducing fever, alleviating pain, and supporting the immune system, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids.
